description: Variation of Condition 1 of planning permission dated 14 August 2025 (RN: 23/06144/FULL) for 'Use of building as 4 no. self-contained residential units (Use Class C3) with associated demolition and replacement of extensions within central courtyard and at roof level; Creation of third floor external terrace; Alterations/replacement of windows; Replacement of rear boundary wall with dwarf wall and metal railings; Installation of air-source heat pumps; and associated works'. Namely to replace green wall within rear lightwell with sedum roof at rear third floor level and at main roof level.Conditions(s) Removal:A living green wall, 9m2 in area, was proposed for the central lightwell. Unfortunately, this location is impractical for sustaining a living green wall due to the lack of daylight.  In lieu of the green wall 2 areas of sedum roof are proposed ? on the 3rd floor roof terrace and part of the main flat roof. The sedum roof specification would match the sedum roof currently forming part of the consented scheme on the Mews House roof, adjacent to Ossington Street.Condition 1 - Replace drawings listed on the 23/06144/FULL / 25/01211/ADFULL consent with the drawings submitted as part of the Section 73 application - please see submitted schedule of drawings.
